mode: Selected existing generated photographic artwork and composed typography and linework separately. No new photograph generated.
comparisonPolicy: Poster: only right-stroke d changes, translating it 50 units upward without changing angle or length. Options: only two path geometries change; all four endpoints and line styles stay fixed. Chart: only the W2-to-W4 bridge opacity changes from 1 to 0; observed segments, points and data are identical. All content, typography, other geometry, photographic data/crops, colors, paper and lighting remain fixed.

verification.textBounds: within paper surface, including nested copy-block transforms
verification.pixelCheck: Only intended declared continuity intervention regions differ.
verification.scope: All six saved browser PNGs visually inspected. Text fits each paper surface and there is no horizontal overflow. Pixel checks isolate declared line-edit regions; DOM comparisons check unchanged copy, endpoints where required, type, image data/crops and unrelated coordinates. Chart bridge visibility is isolated from the unchanged observed segments to avoid unrelated joint rasterization differences. Standalone artwork and article-renderer markup are checked separately.

limitations: No reader study, measured connection-tracing or comprehension benefit, eye-tracking result, physical print trial, assistive-technology audit, whole-artifact accessibility conformance or full production-route result. Diagram routes are conceptual, not physical directions; chart values are fictional.
